description: Responsive layout + accessibility pass + final verification and documentation. Completes mobile stacking (schedule -> details -> list) with horizontal-scroll schedule, a full keyboard/focus/ARIA audit across all interactive elements, and the end-to-end verification + SETUP.md/README finalization. This is the integration-and-polish FEAT; it depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-004 being in place and touches layout/CSS and docs, not core logic.
steps: Finalize responsive layout in Layout.tsx / styles: desktop CSS grid 70%/30% (left stacks ScheduleGrid over DetailsPanel; right is TaskList); at a max-width mobile breakpoint collapse to a single column in order schedule -> details -> list; give ScheduleGrid overflow-x:auto so the Mon–Fri grid scrolls horizontally if needed. Verify no component hardcodes a color — all styling flows through tokens.

Accessibility pass: confirm EVERY interactive element (ScheduleCell, Add task, remove, status toggle, theme/mode/accent/tint/reset controls, admin promote/demote, auth, gear) is a real <button> (or proper input) with a visible :focus-visible ring via --focus-ring; add appropriate aria-labels/roles (e.g. selected ScheduleCell aria-pressed, dialogs with role/aria-modal + focus trap + Escape to close, the 'Officers can edit' tag, pending-dot aria-hidden with text alternative). Confirm the pending cue is non-color (ringed dot) in both modes.
Add any missing RTL tests to cover the a11y contract (focus visible, buttons are buttons, dialog keyboard behavior) and ensure the ConfigError-when-unconfigured test exists.

Finalize SETUP.md and README.md: complete the Google OAuth steps, officer-bootstrap SQL, anon-Realtime verification (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE + replica-identity one-liner), VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK guidance, the current_role_of coupling note, and the full RLS proof curl/manual steps; add a 'running the app / tests / build' quickstart. Ensure .env.example is committed and .env is gitignored.
Full green-build verification in the worktree: npm install (clean), npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build — all must pass. Clean up any temp files created during verification.
Commit locally on branch classboard via git -C c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\classboard. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile stacks schedule -> details -> list and the schedule scrolls horizontally; desktop is 70/30 (criterion from spec).
All interactive elements are real buttons/inputs with visible focus states and appropriate ARIA; the non-color pending cue works in both modes (criterion 6).
SETUP.md/README are complete and accurate: OAuth, officer bootstrap, Realtime verification, fallback flag, RLS proofs; .env.example committed, .env gitignored.
A full clean `npm install && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build` passes in the worktree with no errors.
verification: npm run test -> all unit + component (+ live RLS when backend present, else skipped-with-reason) tests pass
Manual: resize to mobile width and confirm the stack order + horizontal schedule scroll; tab through the UI and confirm visible focus on every control
findings:
SHIPPED. Commit 953c479 on branch classboard (10 files, +371/-79). Full clean verification in the worktree: npm install OK; npm run typecheck 0 errors; npm run lint 0 errors (2 pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components WARNINGS on SessionProvider.tsx + ThemeProvider.tsx, carried from FEAT-002/004, lint exits 0); npm run test = 88 passed | 9 skipped (the 9 are the RLS integration suite skipped-with-reason, no live backend) across 15 files; npm run build OK, dist/index.html inline CBTheme bootstrap preserved and now emits --scrim for both palettes before the app script (no flash).

RESPONSIVE LAYOUT: moved Layout.tsx's inline grid/column styles into base.css CSS classes (inline styles can't do media queries). .board-main = desktop grid-template-columns:70% 30%; .board-left flex-stacks ScheduleGrid over DetailsPanel; .board-right is TaskList. @media (max-width:860px){.board-main{grid-template-columns:1fr}} collapses to ONE column. DOM order is left-column(schedule->details) then right-column(list), so a single column naturally stacks schedule -> details -> list (the required mobile order) with NO order/flex hacks. ScheduleGrid already wraps its <table> in overflow-x:auto (kept) so the Mon-Fri grid scrolls horizontally and never widens the page. Layout.tsx now uses className only for the main/columns; the error-bar/retry inline styles stayed (token-based).

A11Y DIALOGS — NEW shared src/components/Modal.tsx: owns the full dialog a11y contract so each dialog body keeps ONLY its own role=dialog/aria-modal/aria-labelledby card. Modal provides: scrim via the --scrim TOKEN (.modal-scrim class, NOT a hardcoded color); Escape closes (stopPropagation so nested modals don't double-fire); backdrop close on onMouseDown when e.target===scrim (mousedown not click, so a drag ending outside doesn't spuriously close); Tab/Shift+Tab focus TRAP that re-queries focusable descendants on every Tab (stays correct as content changes, e.g. an error appears) using selector 'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input/select/textarea:not([disabled]),[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])' — wraps last->first and first->last; focus MOVES into the first focusable on open and RESTORES to document.activeElement (the opener) on unmount via a useEffect cleanup; the scrim has tabIndex=-1 as a focus landing fallback only. REPLACED the two duplicate ad-hoc overlays: Header.tsx's local <Overlay> (Auth/Admin/Appearance) and TaskList.tsx's inline overlayStyle (AddTaskDialog) both deleted and swapped to <Modal>. This also removed the only two hardcoded colors in components: the rgba(0,0,0,0.5) scrims.

NON-COLOR PENDING CUE: already correct from FEAT-003 (ScheduleCell ringed dot = --accent fill + 1px --dot-ring=--text ring, aria-hidden, PLUS .sr-only '(has pending tasks)' text). FEAT-005 added test coverage asserting the contract rather than changing it.

SCRIM TOKEN: added --scrim to the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH so the pre-paint bootstrap and runtime stay byte-identical (parity test still green). Added scrim to BasePalette interface + DARK_BASE (rgba(5,10,20,0.6)) + LIGHT_BASE (rgba(15,23,42,0.45)) + resolveTokens output ('--scrim': base.scrim) in src/lib/theme-core.ts, and the static fallback --scrim in src/styles/tokens.css under both html[data-mode] blocks. It is a FIXED per-mode value (like --danger), NOT user-themable and NOT accent-derived. GOTCHA for later: theme-core.test.ts uses per-key assertions (not exact-shape toEqual) and theme.test.ts iterates Object.entries(resolveTokens(...)), so adding a token key is safe; a future exact-shape snapshot would need updating.

HARDCODED-COLOR AUDIT: grep of src/components/**/*.tsx for rgba(/#hex after the change leaves ONLY legitimate NON-styling values in AppearancePanel.tsx — ACCENT_PRESETS / TINT_PRESETS (user-selectable color DATA for the picker, the whole point of the feature), the '#FFB547' inside a help-text string, and '#000000' as the native <input type=color> fallback value when no tint is set. No component hardcodes a styling color; all styling flows through tokens.

TESTS ADDED (+9, 79->88): src/components/Modal.test.tsx (7): focus moves in on open; Escape closes; backdrop-click closes but inside-click doesn't; Tab last->first trap; Shift+Tab first->last trap; focus restored to opener on unmount; dialog actions are real <button>s. Extended src/components/ScheduleCell.test.tsx (+2): aria-pressed reflects selection; pending cue is an aria-hidden dot PLUS sr-only text (non-color). jsdom has no native Tab navigation, so the trap tests set document.activeElement via .focus() then fireEvent.keyDown — the Modal handler calls .focus() on preventDefault, which IS exercised (no @testing-library/user-event dependency; project doesn't have it). The ConfigError-when-unconfigured test already existed (src/components/ConfigError.test.tsx) and still passes.

DOCS: SETUP.md was already complete from FEAT-001/002 (env, Google OAuth 5-step, officer-bootstrap SQL by email, Realtime enablement + anon INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE verification + one-line relreplident='d' check, VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK guidance, current_role_of coupling note that it runs on EVERY self-update incl. theme saves, full RLS proof table + curl snippets automated-vs-manual, Local development quickstart) — left as-is, verified accurate. README.md: appended architecture bullets for the --scrim token, the responsive 70/30->single-column(<=860px) stacking, and the a11y contract (real buttons, --focus-ring, shared Modal with focus trap/Escape/restore, non-color pending cue). .env.example is git-tracked; .env is gitignored and absent.

MANUAL (not run here, no live backend / headless): resize to <=860px to confirm schedule->details->list stack + horizontal schedule scroll; tab through every control (schedule cells, add/remove/status, theme controls, admin, auth, gear) to confirm the visible --focus-ring; open any dialog and confirm Escape + focus trap + focus restore. These are documented in FEAT-005 verification + SETUP.md.
